row:
I’m Joe Sharp , a former head physiotherapist in professional football, now helping active people stay active for life.

If you walk, run, lift, ride, hike, swim, or just refuse to sit still, and something’s started to hurt, you’re in the right place.

Active people don’t want to be told to rest. You want to know what’s actually wrong, what fixes it, and how to get back to doing what you love without making it worse.

That’s what this channel is for.

After years working in elite sport and years of running my own physio clinics, I’ve helped thousands of people get out of pain and back to full strength. 

The advice here is the same advice I give my patients and the athletes I’ve worked with, just without the appointment.

Subscribe if you plan on staying active for life. I’ll show you how.
